preview.text: Myanmar won the toss and chose to bat first against Qatar in the T20 match at Selangor Turf Club. The usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches at Selangor Turf Club is 144. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 94 per cent chance of rain and about 31 degrees.

summary.text: Qatar won the match by 9 wickets after restricting MMR to 55-9, during which Htet Lin Oo was the top scorer with 16 off 20 balls and Daniel Louis took 4 for 6. Qatar then chased the target by reaching 56-1, led by Zubair Ali who scored 34 off 24 balls while Pyae Phyo Wai claimed 1 for 22.
